notes: The OG widget’s look is now a theme in its own right. Its colours, type, spacing, corners, weights and timing were only ever written inside the panel itself, so nothing else could wear them. They are now a proper Control Panel theme called…

Every value in it is labelled as either taken straight from the OG panel, scaled from it, or filled in because OG has no such thing. Nine roles the Control Panel needs and OG does not have are listed openly at the foot of the theme rather…
One finding worth recording: OG cannot support a third text shade. Anything dimmer than its existing dim grey fails the readability floor on its own card colour, which the build now checks.

The video card and its settings are unchanged and fully in place. Only YouTube is paused: choosing a YouTube link now says so plainly. A video file from your PC or a direct link to an .mp4 or .webm works exactly as before.
